blocks.text: Formatting rules in the Agentic Security Operations Platform (Agentic SecOps Platform) allows you to apply coloring rules to measurements and dimensions, making data interpretation clear and intuitive. These rules help emphasize key measurements, highlight data based on dimension values, and track trends across dashboards and compliance policies.

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, go to Configure > Formatting Rules.
The Formatting Rules page appears.
See image.
Click New Rule.
The Create Formatting Rule drawer appears.
See image.
In the Create Formatting Rule drawer:
Name: Enter a name (e.g., Policy Compliance Threshold).
Type: Select the rule type:
Numeric Rules
Numeric rules allow you to define custom coloring rules for measurements.
Define the conditions:
Select an operator (e.g., >, <, =, Between).
Enter a threshold value for the condition.
The Between operator requires both a starting and ending value for the numerical range.
Assign a color for the condition (e.g., red for <25%).
(Optional) Click the Delete icon to delete a rule.
See image.
(Optional) Click Add to add a new rule.
See image.
See image.
Numeric rules are evaluated in the order they appear (from top to bottom). When there is an overlap between conditions, the color of the top condition takes priority.
Dimension-Based Rules

Dimension-based rules allow you to define custom coloring rules for dimensions. This is an effective way to visualize good versus bad indicators, such as Severity Levels or risk-based metrics like Asset Criticality.
Select a value from the Dimension drop-down menu.
The dimension values appear.
See image.
Rules can be configured for the top 25 dimension values.
Assign a color to each dimension value.
See image.
This rule applies only to pie, bar, and table charts.
Repeated fields are not currently supported.
In the Fallback Formatting Rule Logic section, select the rule logic when data does not meet the defined conditions:
Back to Default: Restores the default color assigned to the rule.
Customize: Select a color for values that do not meet the conditions.
(Optional) Click Reset to Default to clear all custom inputs and revert the rule configuration to its original state.
Click Save.

blocks.text: You can apply formatting rules to compliance policies or custom dashboards. To learn more, see Configuring Asset Compliance Policies and Configuring Custom Dashboards.

blocks.heading: Applying Formatting Rules to a Widget

blocks.text: To apply a formatting rule to a widget:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, go to Explore > Dashboards.
The All Dashboards page appears.
See image.
Click the dashboard you want to edit.
The selected dashboard appears.
Click the Edit Dashboard icon.
See image.
Hover over the desired widget, and click the Edit icon.
See image.
Click the Style tab.
See image.
Select a formatting rule from the Formatting Rules drop-down menu.
See image.
You can also click New Rule to create a new formatting rule.
Click Save.
Click Save on the dashboard to apply formatting rules to the widget.

blocks.heading: Applying Formatting Rules to a Policy

blocks.text: To apply a formatting rule (numeric rule) to an Asset Exposure Management (AEM) policy:

blocks.item: In the Agentic SecOps Platform Admin Portal, click Assets in the top navigation bar.
In the left-side navigation, click Policies.
The Policies page appears.
See image.
Hover over the policy, and click the Edit icon.
See image.
The Edit Policy page appears.
In the Formatting Rule section, select the relevant formatting rule.
See image.
You can also click New Rule to create a new formatting rule.
Click Save to apply the rule to the policy.
